*.lng_rnd_dept_aero_overview_description: The Aerodynamics department develops the flat-bottom car: nose, wings, diffuser and sidepods. Downforce costs straight-line speed; tighter sidepods cost cooling.
*.lng_rnd_dept_chassis_overview_descriptio: The Chassis & Suspension department builds the carbon tub, the suspension and the brakes, takes the car towards the 500 kg limit and runs the B-spec car and active suspension projects.
*.lng_rnd_dept_engine_overview_description: The Engine department works with the engine supplier on power, revs and fuel consumption, with no refuelling allowed. A works engine goes further than a customer one. The qualifying line only works in qualifying.
*.lng_rnd_dept_maintenance_overview_descri: The Reliability & Gearbox department fights the retirements of 1990: gearbox, engine, cooling and electrics, and the semi-automatic gearbox project.
